title: Workspace recovery
purpose: Back up your workspace or recover it from an archive.
unsupportedDetail: This desktop version does not support workspace backup and recovery.
browserUnavailable: Open OffGrid desktop to manage local workspace recovery.
permissionRequired: Sign in as an administrator to manage workspace recovery.
externalUnavailable: This service is managed externally. Use the workspace recovery CLI on its host.
unavailableStatus: Recovery is unavailable. Check the desktop and service details.
statusFailed: Recovery status could not be checked.
requestUnconfirmed: The recovery request could not be confirmed. Check its status before trying again.
restoreDestination: Choose a new restored workspace folder
invalidPassphrase: Enter a matching passphrase of 1 to 4096 UTF-8 bytes without line breaks.
secretDetail: The passphrase stays in this local host dialog. Keep a recovery copy separately; OffGrid cannot recover a lost passphrase.
confirmDetail: OffGrid will stop current local work and drain the service before this operation. The original workspace stays stopped until you choose Resume. A restored directory is never activated automatically.
scope: Only workspace data is included. Models and configuration outside this directory need separate backups.
unavailable: Recovery needs an administrator session in a desktop-owned workspace. For an external service, run the workspace recovery CLI on its host.
boundary: Choose files and enter credentials in the desktop dialogs. Local work stops for this operation; restored data is never activated automatically.
selecting: Choose files in the desktop dialog
failed: Recovery could not finish. Review the selected archive, key, permissions and available space before retrying.
uncertain: Stopping could not be confirmed. Inspect the local process and retained files before proceeding.
stopped: The original workspace is stopped. Resume it explicitly when ready.
authenticated: Archive encryption and complete authentication verified
published: The new destination was published and retained.
retainedDetail: Inspect these paths before manual cleanup. OffGrid will not reuse or remove them automatically.
plaintext: This retained location contains unencrypted private data.
